method.description: Independent float64 reimplementation of the 8D COM-relative Newtonian dynamics and analytic variational equations. Both catalog endpoints were independently shooting-corrected, then the edge was walked with 12 equal mass substeps in each direction using a secant chart predictor and analytic monodromy shooting corrector.

conclusion: The previously failing global-rank-3 MST edge is continuation-connected in both directions at 12 substeps without relaxing either scientific acceptance threshold. The earlier six-substep failure is therefore consistent with branch-basin/chart-conditioning sensitivity rather than evidence of a moduli-space disconnection. Gate C remains pending until the rest of the globally worst-edge matrix and required generic/path-diverse fallbacks close.
